name: etamil-ide
description: CodeMirror 6 editor for eTamil, built into ../assets/ide for the Jekyll site to serve.

scripts.wasm: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --no-default-features --lib --manifest-path ../../eTamil/etamil_compiler/Cargo.toml && wasm-bindgen --target web --no-typescript --out-dir wasm --out-name etamil_compiler ../../eTamil/etamil_compiler/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/etamil_compiler.wasm
